recommendation: Keep the source fix. It is a narrow completion of the already-applied FHIR-19470 rename and does not attempt broader MedicationStatement status/adherence redesign.
issue_request: FHIR-19470 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked Pharmacy to replace MedicationUsage.takenAsOrdered with a CodeableConcept adherence attribute and rename takenAsOrdered to adherence.
initial_application: The issue was first partially applied in 2019, then f351511a95 changed MedicationUsage.takenAsOrdered to MedicationUsage.adherence in the StructureDefinition and search expression. The FHIR-38682 rename-back commit b2032629f2 converted the resource to MedicationStatement but carried the stale takenAsOrdered path extension forward.
additional_context: FHIR-19468 is the paired status/not-taking decision. FHIR-31573 and FHIR-39271, already represented on the combined branch, confirm that current MedicationStatement taking/not-taking semantics are expressed through adherence rather than status or takenAsOrdered.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationstatement/bundle-MedicationStatement-search-params.xml so the adherence SearchParameter path extension now says MedicationStatement.adherence, matching the id, URL, code, description, and MedicationStatement.adherence.code expression.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/bundle-MedicationStatement-search-params.xml: changed the adherence SearchParameter path metadata from MedicationStatement.takenAsOrdered to MedicationStatement.adherence.

related_jiras.note: Paired decision removing not-taken from MedicationUsage.status and using adherence for taking/not-taking semantics.
Later corrected effective[x] to refer to adherence; already represented on the combined branch.
Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement and explains how the stale path reached current source.
Confirms the status/adherence model used to interpret the source fix; already represented on the combined branch.
